children: Rane (Madras) Ltd on Tuesday reported a multi-fold increase in consolidated net profit to ₹327 crore for the quarter ended September 2026 (Q2FY27) on the back of a one-time gain in sale of land.
The auto component major reported net profit of ₹21 crore in the same quarter last year.
Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2FY27 stood at ₹1,237 crore, a  35 per cent YoY growth. This includes sales of the acquired Friction business with effect from August 20.

A  company statement said sales to Domestic OE customers grew by 31% mainly due to higher offtake across vehicle segments. Sales to International customers increased by 57% supported by strong offtake of steering products. Sales to Indian Aftermarket customers increased by 11%.
The gain on sale of land amounts to around ₹340 crore and relates to the sale of a 3.48 acre land parcel situated at Velachery by Rane.

During Q2 FY27, Rane incurred capex of ₹74.8 crore. The majority of the investments were directed towards steering and linkages and brake components divisions. Capital expenditure in H1FY27 is approximately ₹50 crore higher compared to H1 FY26, directed toward scaling manufacturing capacity and supporting new business wins, Rane said.

Rane, which is a manufacturer of Steering and Suspension systems, Brake components, Engine components and Light Metal Casting components, added ₹614 Crores in new order Lifetime Value (LTV) this quarter, building upon the ₹2,040 Crore booked in the prior quarter.
The shares of Rane (Madras) ended the trading day at Rs 1,272, up 3.31 per cent on the NSE.

title: Rane (Madras) Q2 PAT soars on one-time gain, revenue up 35%
